Resolves #19681

Headless Chrome's e2e screen goes from 1920×1080 to 2560×1440. The multi-window journeys drive popups beside a 1280×720 main window, and at 1920×1080 the window manager refused or clamped those moves. One line in `gpuIntent.mjs` `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` changes, with the JSDoc's reason updated; `glState.spec.mjs` pins the new value.

Evidence: L2 (one-runner A/Bs and a pre-merge ten-shard sample, all hosted, from temporary branches) → L2 required (AC-2 asks for the hosted sample). Residual: the next `dev`-push receipts. Residual-Owner: #19657.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `--screen-info={2560x1440}`, and the JSDoc explains that the journeys need room beside a 1280×720 window. `glState.spec.mjs` asserts the value in both launch profiles: 11 passed. |
| AC-2 | [Ten-shard sample at this change](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38300845779), on probe Engine `2b761a5640a3bbca8999e27a83da703b15d91c74` (based on `dev` `a854f87da3`; identical `gpuIntent.mjs` blob to the PR): 253 passed, 4 failed, 3 skipped, every shard 3m31s or less. The four reds are all from the known intermittent set: `LegacyPopupReturnNL:12`, `WorkstationPopOutHoverSyncNL:90`, `WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL:236`, `DockSplitterZoneIdNL:54`. No new red against [the previous sample](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38291666072) (8 reds). `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL:388` ran and passed, and the three skips are the same `WorkstationFiveBeatNL` tests as before. |
| AC-3 | The engine tier runs on this PR. |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

## Test Evidence
- [Drag-affordances A/B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38297274450), one runner, ×3 per screen. At 1920×1080, `:388` skipped every round on its own guard (every `window.moveTo` refused). At 2560×1440 the whole file passed every round.
- [Popup-group A/B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38297993405), one runner per group, ×2 per screen:
  - `WorkstationFilmTourNL:302`: 0/2 → 2/2;
  - `WorkstationFilmTourNL:223`: 0/2 → 1/2;
  - `WorkstationNL:2604`: 0/2 → 2/2;
  - the FilmTour file: 7 min → 2.5–4.7 min;
  - `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL:148`, `WorkstationPopOutPaneIdentityNL`, `LegacyPopupReturnNL` and `WorkstationPopOutSparklinesNL:74`: no better on either screen, so they stay in #19657's set.
- `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL`, the wide-branch control from `#19309`, narrows only below 980 px, so it takes the same branch at 2560.
- `check-ticket-archaeology`: 0 violations.
